versions.content: If development error detection for the module Eep is enabled, and if the function Eep_GetVersionInfo is called with a NULL Pointer, the function Eep_GetVersionInfo shall raise the development error EEP_E_PARAM_POINTER , otherwise (if no development error detection is enabled) it shall return without any action.
